prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1021; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Pearland?

A: I was making a left turn across the opposing lanes. The light had changed to green for me, or at least I believed it had. I started the turn and a vehicle coming from the other direction struck the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. I was watching for oncoming traffic, but it came up faster than I expected. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?

A: The front airbags did, and the steering wheel hit my left wrist hard when I tried to hold on to it.

Q: Have you received medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I was taken to an urgent care clinic that evening, and they took X-rays. The doctor told me I have a fracture in my wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I have a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else about the accident you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've been unable to work my usual schedule since then, because I use that hand for most of my job. I'm hoping to get my vehicle repaired and recover fully.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
